entities.name: Ghana-India Kofi Annan Centre of Excellence in ICT
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Ghana-India Kofi Annan Centre of Excellence in ICT (AITI-KACE) is Ghana's first Advanced Information Technology Institute (AITI). It was established in 2003, through a partnership between the government of Ghana and the government of India.
